title: The link that says a letter was uploaded for a submission
assertion: In Postgres, `source_document.filed_for_submission_id` is written only when the document is inserted: a top-level document carrying it is a payer letter, uploaded in their own name by a person who logs submissions, for the latest submission of a case of its practice, and a job, a person without that permission, another person’s name, another kind, an earlier submission, a made-up submission and another practice’s submission are each refused with nothing written; a zip’s entry takes its zip’s link and one naming another is refused, and no role moves a document under or out of a zip afterwards; the link never changes, by the application role (which holds no right to update it) or by the owner; a zip’s row is read from the practice’s documents even when a temporary table of that name comes first in the session; a letter carrying the link is not a document awaiting abstraction and no contract version names it; until the web writes the link it is empty everywhere and nothing a person sees changes
noFileReason: Documents and submissions the test inserts on synthetic practices it creates: no file.
